facts.fact: ANSSI CI names Law No. 2013-546 of 30 July 2013 on electronic transactions as part of the regulatory framework in force that gives the electronic signature legal value.
ANSSI CI names Decree No. 2014-106 of 12 March 2014, setting the conditions for written records and electronic signature, and Decree No. 2014-105 on cryptology services, as rules under the framework.
